title: Privacy Act (APPs) readiness
heading:
How ready are you for the
Australian Privacy Principles?
lead: Eight quick questions across the Australian Privacy Principles and the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme show how well you handle personal information, and where the gaps are.

items.name: Privacy governance
items.q: Do you have a privacy policy and clear ownership of privacy?
opts: Neither in place.
A basic policy, no clear owner.
A current policy with an accountable owner.
Governed privacy program, reviewed and resourced.

items.name: Knowing what you hold
items.q: Do you know what personal information you collect and where it lives?
opts: No clear picture.
A rough idea for key systems.
A documented record of personal information.
A maintained data map covering collection, use and storage.

items.name: Collection & consent
items.q: Is personal information collected fairly, with notice and consent?
opts: Not considered.
Sometimes, inconsistently.
Collection notices and consent are in place.
Consistent, minimal collection with clear notices and records.

items.name: Access & correction
items.q: Can individuals access and correct their personal information?
opts: No process.
Handled ad hoc.
A defined process for access and correction requests.
A tracked, timely process with records.

items.name: Security of personal info
items.q: Is personal information protected with appropriate security?
opts: Minimal protection.
Some controls.
Access control, encryption and monitoring in place.
Strong, tested controls proportionate to sensitivity.

items.name: Disclosure & overseas
items.q: Are disclosures and any overseas transfers controlled?
opts: Not tracked.
Considered occasionally.
Disclosures governed, overseas transfers assessed.
Full controls with contracts and due diligence for third parties.

items.name: Breach response (NDB)
items.q: Could you assess and notify an eligible data breach in time?
opts: No process.
A rough idea.
A documented breach response process aligned to the NDB scheme.
A tested process with defined roles, timelines and templates.

items.name: Retention & destruction
items.q: Is personal information kept only as long as needed and then destroyed?
opts: Kept indefinitely.
Some ad hoc clean-up.
Retention rules exist and are mostly followed.
Enforced retention and secure destruction schedules.
